items.description: Patching and repainting finished wall in reading room damaged by Ridgeline Drywall's cart (on hold pending photo review)

amountEvidence.sentence: We have about $1,060 in patching and repainting after Ridgeline Drywall's cart hit the finished wall in the Lakeview Library reading room.

disputeEvidence.sentence: I told them we'd be issuing a back-charge, but their foreman is disputing it and says another crew made the damage.
